scope: Authenticated live POS quote flow at 390px. One product was added only to a temporary Playwright cart. Checkout, payment and business writes were prohibited.

quoteHandlerReview.assessment: Read-only Odoo pricing, tax and register lookups.

limitations: The temporary browser cart was discarded when the Playwright context closed.
This does not verify checkout, payment capture, receipt persistence, refunds, cash movements, register close or sale/stock reconciliation.
Odoo isolated-write attestation is not verified. Pilot remains NO-GO for business transaction acceptance.
